messages:
incident-bot: Alert ROUTER_HIGH_ERROR rate=5m breach for project: payment-gateway — severity: P1. Attempting to page oncall. PagerBridge delivery status: 503 -> circuit-breaker tripped :warning:
ops-bot: Outbound paging suppressed by circuit-breaker circuit_id=cb-42, reason=error_rate_above_threshold (threshold=0.05, observed=0.18)
emily: i didn't get a page, saw the dashboard spike at 13:12 but no pager. slack alert only.
carla: support getting customer report: 'we got 5xxs and didn't see any red phone call' — multiple customers impacted, escalated to SE.
raj: looking at pagerbridge logs now, grabbing recent lines. can someone verify oncall mapping?
raj: ```
2026-04-02T13:11:23Z PagerBridge->outbound POST /send 503 {"err":"upstream timeout"}
2026-04-02T13:12:01Z CircuitBreaker(cb-42) state=OPEN, window_errors=27, window_total=150
2026-04-02T13:12:01Z Suppressing page for incident_id=inc-20421 route=pagerduty
```
raj: cb opened at 13:12:01 and stayed open for ~7m before auto-reset. that matches the missing pages window.
emily: can we force an immediate manual page while we fix it? some customers reported 5+ failed requests.
dave: yes, manual page now. @emily @lena i'll trigger manual paging and do a follow-up.
dave: ```
# manual poke to bypass cb
curl -X POST https://pagerbridge.internal/send -H "Authorization: Token $SECRET" -d '{"incident_id":"inc-20421","method":"sms,call"}'
```
ops-bot: Manual send accepted, outbound attempts started at 13:19:05. delivery results: 40/42 delivered to SMS, 38/42 delivered to voice.
emily: thanks. paging got through now. still need root cause and why cb threshold didn't factor in transient upstream latency.
raj: initial theory: a mis-tuned sliding window combined with a recent deploy that changed retry behavior for /send. code change reduced retries from 3->1 so transient upstream failures bumped error fraction.
carla: customer success notified impacted accounts (acct_889, acct_1012). CS asks for postmortem and timeline.
lena: FYI CS already emailed those customers with workaround and ETA. want the mitigation timeline to include manual page times.
raj: rolling back the retry change in a canary to test. patch pushed to staging at 13:32 and will roll to prod if green.
dave: also lowering circuit-breaker sensitivity and increasing cooldown to avoid suppressing on short bursts. will coordinate with Raj.
emily: what about alerting on suppressed-pages? we should have a higher-priority meta-alert when cb suppresses > 3 pages in 5m. I didn't see that.
raj: good point — existing metric only logs cb.open, not suppressed_pages_count as an alerting signal. adding a short-lived rule now.
raj: quick commands:
```
# monitor suppressed pages metric
kubectl logs -l app=pagerbridge -c pagerbridge | jq 'select(.event=="suppressed_page")' | wc -l
```
emily: postmortem owners? I can write primary timeline, raj for infra root cause, carla/lena for customer comms. dave to sign-off on follow-up fixes.
dave: agreed. severity P1 for missing pages to oncall; add postmortem link once draft is ready.
carla: noted customers want credit + detailed timeline. we'll gather exact affected windows and deliveries.
ops-bot: Incident ticket INC-20421 created and assigned to eng-sre. Slack thread pinned in #incidents.
emily: final note — we likely need a test that simulates partial upstream outage + low retries to reproduce. raj pls include that in remediation checklist. :thumbsup:
raj: will add unit + e2e test and set cb threshold back to previous sensible defaults.
